description: Bill Payment Reminders - Push notifications for bills due in 3 days, 1 day, and on due date, with 'Mark as Paid' quick action.
steps: Enhance existing notification_service.dart to add bill reminder methods: scheduleBillReminder(billId, billTitle, amount, dueDate) that schedules 3 notifications at: 3 days before (at 9 AM), 1 day before (at 6 PM), and on due date (at 8 AM)

Add checkAndScheduleBillReminders() method to notification_service.dart that: (1) queries all recurring bills from DBService.getRecurring() where is_expense=1, (2) calculates next_date from recurring records, (3) schedules reminders for bills due within next 7 days, (4) stores 'last_reminder_check' timestamp in settings to avoid duplicate scheduling
Enhance notification payload handling in notification_service.dart's init() to include 'bill_id' in payload so tapping notification can navigate to bill detail or mark-as-paid dialog

Create quick action notification with 2 buttons: 'Mark as Paid' and 'View Details'. Mark as Paid button creates expense record for the bill amount and advances next_date by frequency (monthly +1 month, etc.)
Add bill reminder preference toggle in settings_screen.dart: 'Bill Reminders' switch (default ON) with info explaining reminder schedule (3 days, 1 day, due date)
Call NotificationService.checkAndScheduleBillReminders() from home_screen.dart initState and also after any bill is added/updated in recurring_screen.dart to keep reminders current
acceptance_criteria: Bills due within 7 days have reminders scheduled at correct times (3 days before, 1 day before, due date)
Tapping notification navigates to bill details or shows mark-as-paid dialog
'Mark as Paid' quick action creates expense and advances next due date automatically
Reminders respect user preference toggle in settings
No duplicate notifications scheduled for same bill
Reminders update when bills are added/modified/deleted
verification: Test scenario 1: Add recurring bill with due date 2 days from now → receive notification at 9 AM today (3-day reminder), then again tomorrow at 6 PM (1-day reminder), then on due date at 8 AM
Test scenario 2: Tap 'Mark as Paid' on notification → expense created for bill amount with correct category and date, bill's next_date advanced by 1 month
Test scenario 3: Disable 'Bill Reminders' in settings → no new notifications scheduled
Test scenario 4: Delete a bill → scheduled notifications for that bill are canceled
Test scenario 5: Modify bill due date → notifications rescheduled to new dates
